fit_bayesian_ridge_cubic: fit a BayesianRidge model with a cubic polynomial to approximate a noisy sinusoid
predict_with_uncertainty: predict mean and standard deviation from a fitted BayesianRidge model using return_std
set_bayesian_ridge_params: set alpha_init and lambda_init on a BayesianRidge model to control regularization convergence
generate_sin_dataset: generate a noisy sinusoidal dataset with uniform training points and dense test points
evaluate_log_marginal_likelihood: compare BayesianRidge models by evaluating log marginal likelihood scores
